scene_zh: 一份白领薪资样本（模拟数据）

views.subject: years of experience and monthly salary
views.subtitle_en: Years of experience plotted against monthly salary.

examples.en: Pay tends to rise with experience: 5 years brings 11.5 thousand CNY a month, and 20 years brings 22.
examples.zh: 月薪随工龄上升：5 年 11.5 千元，20 年 22 千元。

features.note_zh: tend to 是描述中等相关的安全说法，不给绝对结论。
features.interpret_zh: 整体向上，但同样工龄的人差距很大，工龄只能解释一部分。

examples.en: From 4 to 8 years the dots climb steadily, from 9.8 to 16.2 thousand CNY a month.
examples.zh: 4 到 8 年这一段稳定上升，从 9.8 千元到 16.2 千元。

features.note_zh: 这一段点贴得近，用 climb steadily / a tight pattern。
features.interpret_zh: 早期涨薪节奏整齐，但不代表每个人都能按这个速度涨。

examples.en: Mid-career dots bunch together: 9 to 17 years all fall between 15.8 and 20.5 thousand CNY a month.
examples.zh: 中段工龄的点挤在一起：9 到 17 年都落在 15.8 到 20.5 千元之间。

features.note_zh: bunch together / a dense band 描述竖直方向变化很小的密集带。
features.interpret_zh: 工龄涨了八年，工资带只差不到五千，说明中段涨薪慢。

examples.en: One dot with 1 year of experience sits at 28 thousand CNY, far above the rest.
examples.zh: 有一个点只有 1 年工龄，月薪却有 28 千元，远高于其他点。

features.note_zh: outlier；描述离群点先给出它的位置，再给数值。
features.interpret_zh: 一年经验拿 28k 可能是特殊岗位或记录错误，不能当普遍现象。

examples.en: Another dot sits below the pattern: 18 years of experience and only 9 thousand CNY a month.
examples.zh: 还有一个点低于整体趋势：18 年工龄，月薪只有 9 千元。

features.note_zh: below the pattern 比 low 更准确地描述离群点。
features.interpret_zh: 工龄长但工资低，可能转行或兼职，图里没有这些信息。

views.overview_zh: 整体上工龄越长月薪越高，但关系只是中等；4 到 8 年这一段最整齐，9 到 17 年挤成一条窄带，两头各有一个离群点。相关不等于因果。

general.a2: People with more experience usually earn more. Five years brings about 11.5 thousand CNY a month, and 20 years brings 22. Two people do not fit: one with 1 year earns 28, one with 18 years earns 9.
general.b1: Monthly salary tends to rise with experience, from about 6 thousand CNY at the start to 22 at 20 years. Between 9 and 17 years most salaries sit in a narrow band, and two outliers stand apart.
general.b2: The scatter shows a moderate positive association between experience and monthly salary, rising from 6 thousand CNY at 0 years to 22 at 20 years. Mid-career pay is tightly clustered between 15.8 and 20.5 thousand, while two observations, 1 year at 28 thousand and 18 years at 9 thousand, sit far from the trend.

descriptions.ielts: Monthly salary rose with years of experience, from 6 thousand CNY at 0 years to 22 thousand at 20 years, though the relationship was moderate. Most mid-career salaries fell between 15.8 and 20.5 thousand, and two outliers were recorded.
descriptions.business: Pay rises with experience, but the link is only moderate: the same years of service can come with very different salaries. Mid-career pay narrows into a 15.8 to 20.5 thousand CNY band, and the two outliers are worth checking before using experience as a pay benchmark.

views.subject: Monthly salary by city

examples.en: Beijing has the highest average salary, at 18,500 CNY a month.
examples.zh: 北京平均月薪最高，为 18,500 元。

features.note_zh: the highest + 名词 + at + 数值；salary 用 high 修饰。
features.interpret_zh: 北京最高，但这个数字不扣房租和生活成本，实际可支配收入要看别的数据。

examples.en: Shanghai is close behind, at 17,800, just 700 CNY below Beijing.
examples.zh: 上海紧随其后，为 17,800 元，只比北京低 700 元。

features.note_zh: close behind / a narrow gap；only 强调差距小。
features.interpret_zh: 上海和北京几乎持平，排名先后意义不大。

examples.en: Shenzhen comes third, at 17,200 CNY a month.
examples.zh: 深圳排第三，月薪 17,200 元。

features.note_zh: come + 序数词，比 rank third 更口语；名次前不加 the。
features.interpret_zh: 前三名差距很小，合起来更像同一档，而不是三个等级。

examples.en: Hangzhou sits in the middle of the range, at 14,600 CNY a month.
examples.zh: 杭州处在中间位置，月薪 14,600 元。

features.note_zh: sit at / in the middle of the range；单值描述用 stand at 也常见。
features.interpret_zh: 中间位置说明它是这组城市的过渡点，不代表全国中位数。

examples.en: Wuhan is 6,700 CNY below Beijing, the widest gap in the chart.
examples.zh: 武汉比北京低 6,700 元，是图中最大的差距。

features.note_zh: below / a gap of X between Y and Z；比较水平用 below，不用 under。
features.interpret_zh: 最低和最高差 6,700 元，超过北京的三分之一。

views.overview_zh: 六个城市从 18,500 到 11,800 元递减：北京、上海、深圳接近，杭州居中，成都和武汉明显低一档。平均工资不含房租和生活成本。

general.a2: Beijing has the highest salary, at 18,500 CNY a month. Wuhan is the lowest, at 11,800. Shanghai and Shenzhen are close to Beijing. The other cities fall between them.
general.b1: Average salaries range from 18,500 CNY a month in Beijing to 11,800 in Wuhan. Shanghai and Shenzhen follow close behind Beijing, while Hangzhou sits in the middle at 14,600 and Chengdu at 12,400.
general.b2: Average monthly salary falls from 18,500 CNY in Beijing to 11,800 in Wuhan. The top three cities are within 1,300 CNY of each other, but the gap widens below them: Hangzhou stands at 14,600, Chengdu at 12,400, and Wuhan 6,700 below Beijing.

descriptions.ielts: Beijing recorded the highest average salary at 18,500 CNY a month, followed by Shanghai and Shenzhen at 17,800 and 17,200. Wuhan had the lowest figure at 11,800, while Hangzhou and Chengdu stood at 14,600 and 12,400.
descriptions.business: The top three cities sit within 1,300 CNY of one another, making them effectively one pay band. Hangzhou and Chengdu form a second tier, and Wuhan trails Beijing by 6,700 CNY, a gap that rent and living costs would need to offset.
